newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-UHISPANK NOT TO REVISE PROFIT ESTIMATE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-UHISPANK NOT TO REVISE PROFIT ESTIMATE.

text.p: Uhispank's first quarter results show the bank has a good chance of meeting its annual profit forecast but the bank will not revise it, it said on Monday.
"We have filled 28.2 percent of our profit estimate, which we consider as a good result," Ulo Suurkask, bank vice-president, told a news conference.
"We do not see a need to revise the estimate," he added.
"The profit estimate was made conservatively, taking into account the possible losses, which may come from the merger of two banks," he added.
Uhispank first quarter net profit was 24.5 million kroons and Pohja-Eesti Pank, which will merge with the bank at the end of April, had 5.3 million kroons of profit.
The annual profit estimate of the combined banks 105.8 million kroons.
The merger process between Uhispank and Pohja-Eesti Pank has mostly been completed, Suurkask added.
Uhispank and Pohja-Eesti Pank have not yet consolidated their balance sheets but Uhispank has taken over some of Pohja-Eesti Pank's loan portfolio worth 168 million kroons.
